text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The shopping district's piping hot 
croquettes truly are a force to be 
reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I'm tired of every diet out 
there. Maybe I should just accept this as 
is—"

—Hiiiii, lost little lamb over there! If 
that's how it is, why not leave it to me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but victory is mine today! Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I don't intend to just hand it over, 
you know? CB-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... your high-spirited energy is 
admirable as always, but... the 
underclassmen look rather bewildered at 
the entrance, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, care to join in, Rudolf? You'd make 
the perfect opponent for a bet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A bet? Just what are you two competing 
over?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The right to have any wish granted by 
whoever keeps dancing until the very 
end"... is what it is!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So basically, if I win, you're gonna be my 
running partner for a whole week!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, nice idea, Maruzen. With this, 
dieting won't get boring at all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh, I see. If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indomitable perseverance! This time for 
sure, I'm going to make you turn in all 
those backed-up reports, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no you don't! The two of you are going 
on a groovy date with me♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, awesome! Let's go all out against 
each other! Rudolf, Maruzen!

...And so, Mr. C.B. had a blast dancing 
with her friends, and her diet was a 
roaring success!
